mapper.select: SELECT T.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , T.REGION_NO AS regionNo , T.TRAVEL_NAME AS travelName , T.TRAVEL_STATUS AS travelStatus , T.TRAVEL_ADDRESS AS travelAddress , T.MAP_X AS mapX , T.MAP_Y AS mapY , T.COUNT AS count , T.TRAVEL_IMAGE AS travelImage , R.REGION_NAME AS regionName , T.TRAVEL_CONTENT AS travelContent FROM TB_TRAVEL T LEFT JOIN TB_REGION R ON T.REGION_NO = R.REGION_NO WHERE TRAVEL_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY T.TRAVEL_NO ASC
